name: ses-lockdown
description: Tether Secure Browser v1.7.2 (mid-exam remote-session monitoring: the REMOTE_DESKTOP_SESSION capability is now polled continuously while an exam is ACTIVE, not just at preflight — see remoteSessionMonitor.ts/remoteSessionMonitorLogic.ts — reusing the existing REMOTE_CONTROL_SOFTWARE_DETECTED/PROHIBITED_APPLICATION_CLOSED event model, deduplicated state transitions, and an event-triggered evidence frame; also fixes a latent poll-serialization bug in processDetection.ts where a `.finally()`-wrapped promise's identity could never match its own in-flight guard, silently freezing during-exam process detection at its first scan result for the rest of the exam. Built on v1.7.1's destroyed-window crash fix: restoreLockdownControls/reportAuditFactBestEffort could throw 'Object has been destroyed' when the BrowserWindow's closed event fired, crashing the main process — restoration is now independent of any window and audit reporting is routed through a shared isWindowUsable/runOnWindowBestEffort guard. Built on v1.7.0's Tether Windows Lockdown Hardening v1 — adds a Windows-only process-detection service for known remote-control/debugging/virtualization/screen-capture applications, a remote-session/VM indicator, a main-owned preflight gate and during-exam blocking overlay, an idempotent restoration lifecycle, and materially strengthened Electron hardening: a permission allowlist, denied navigation/window.open/downloads, packaged-build DevTools prevention, rejected unsafe command-line switches, and blocked browser-chrome keyboard shortcuts. See docs/tether-windows-lockdown-hardening-v1.md. v1.4.0 and v1.5.0 were development-only, never distributed.)

scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --dir && npm run verify:package
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir && npm run embed:icon && electron-builder --win --prepackaged release/win-unpacked && npm run verify:package -- release/win-unpacked
